name: Moco Shirts
old_description: Moco Shirts has worked with more than 5000 businesses, teams, non profit organizations, churches, and other organizations for custom screen print shirts since 2014. We understand that shopping for custom screen printing online can be an overwhelming task and we are here to help! Whether you have questions about bulk custom t shirts or custom screen printing in nc our knowledgeable staff has the answers.
about:
Moco Shirts was founded in 2014 as a family-owned screen printing and embroidery shop in Union, West Virginia. The business began with a focus on serving local schools, teams, and organizations across the southern part of the state.

Today the company operates two storefronts — its original Union location on Main Street and a second shop in the Red Oaks Shopping Center near Ronceverte — providing in-house screen printing, embroidery, team apparel, and sign and banner production. The shop handles custom designs for everything from jerseys and uniforms to yard signs and aluminum banners, emphasizing consistent quality through internal production.

Its customer base spans schools, businesses, non-profits, churches, and youth leagues throughout Monroe, Greenbrier, Mercer, and neighboring counties. Named school partners include James Monroe, Greenbrier East, Greenbrier West, and Peterstown, while the company also supplies workwear for local businesses and spirit wear for community events in towns such as Lewisburg, Fairlea, and Princeton.

The founders positioned Moco Shirts as a community-rooted operation, promoting a "built here, for here" ethos that stresses personal service and local decision-making rather than national-scale automation.
